441:     if query_prompt:
442:         raise RuntimeError("DENSE_QUERY_PROMPT_MUST_BE_EMPTY")
443:     return query_prompt
444: 
445: 
446: def build_or_reuse_evaluation_dense_cache(
447:     *,
448:     corpus_dir: Path,
449:     cache_root: Path,
450:     embedding_model_path: Path,
451:     embedding_batch_size: int = 8,
452:     query_prompt_name: str | None = None,
453: ) -> EvaluationDenseCacheResult:
454:     """构建一次或验证复用 synthetic Dense READY cache（staging → atomic publish）。
455: 
456:     identity 只绑定 semantic 输入；query-time / batch 不进入 key。构建时显式复核
457:     真实 model/config 符合 frozen facts（dimension、prompt 为空、model ref），
458:     不满足即 fail closed（STOP / ESCALATE_TO_CODEX）。
459:     """
460:     started = time.monotonic()
461:     # P1-01：在任何 cache lookup / identity 计算 / cold build 之前，先强制冻结
462:     # caller model ref 与 query prompt（与 warm load 同一 Authority）。
463:     model_dir = Path(embedding_model_path).resolve()
464:     query_prompt = _assert_frozen_dense_query_config(
465:         embedding_model_path=model_dir, query_prompt_name=query_prompt_name
466:     )
467:     root = cache_root.resolve(strict=False)
468:     root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
469:     chunks, document_count = prepare_evaluation_chunks(corpus_dir)
470:     if not chunks:
471:         raise ValueError("evaluation corpus produced no chunks")
472:     source_digest = source_manifest_digest(corpus_dir)
473:     chunk_digest = ordered_chunk_manifest_digest(chunks)
474:     identity = evaluation_dense_cache_identity(
475:         source_manifest_sha256=source_digest,
476:         chunk_manifest_sha256=chunk_digest,
477:         embedding_model=EMBEDDING_MODEL_NAME,
478:         embedding_query_prompt=query_prompt,
479:     )
480:     cache_dir = root / identity.cache_key
481:     try:
482:         hit = _validate_ready_dense_cache(
483:             cache_dir=cache_dir,
484:             identity=identity,
485:             document_count=document_count,
486:             chunk_count=len(chunks),
487:             embedding_model=EMBEDDING_MODEL_NAME,
488:             query_prompt=query_prompt,
489:         )
490:     except ValueError as error:
491:         if cache_dir.exists() and not str(error).startswith("CACHE_INCOMPLETE"):
492:             raise
493:     else:
494:         return hit
495: 
496:     lock_path = _acquire_build_lock(root, identity.cache_key)
497:     try:
498:         if cache_dir.exists():
499:             return _validate_ready_dense_cache(
500:                 cache_dir=cache_dir,
501:                 identity=identity,
502:                 document_count=document_count,
503:                 chunk_count=len(chunks),
504:                 embedding_model=EMBEDDING_MODEL_NAME,
505:                 query_prompt=query_prompt,
506:             )
507:         build_dir = root / f".{identity.cache_key}.building-{os.getpid()}"
508:         if build_dir.exists():
509:             raise RuntimeError("CACHE_INCOMPLETE: stale local build directory requires operator inspection")
510:         build_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
511:         manager, manifest = build_evaluation_kb(
512:             persist_dir=build_dir / "chroma",
513:             embedding_model_path=model_dir,
514:             corpus_dir=corpus_dir,
515:             embedding_batch_size=embedding_batch_size,
516:             query_prompt_name=None,
517:         )
518:         actual_dimension = manifest.embedding_dimension
519:         if actual_dimension != DENSE_DIMENSION:
520:             raise RuntimeError(
521:                 f"EMBEDDING_DIMENSION_MISMATCH: expected {DENSE_DIMENSION}, got {actual_dimension}"
522:             )
523:         if manager._query_prompt_name:  # frozen prompt 必须为空
524:             raise RuntimeError("EMBEDDING_QUERY_PROMPT_MUST_BE_EMPTY")
525:         if manifest.document_count != document_count or manifest.chunk_count != len(chunks):
526:             raise RuntimeError("CACHE_INVALID: built index count mismatch")
527:         metadata = _expected_dense_metadata(
528:             identity,
529:             document_count=document_count,
530:             chunk_count=len(chunks),
531:             embedding_model=EMBEDDING_MODEL_NAME,
532:             query_prompt=query_prompt,
533:         )
534:         metadata.update({"created_at": time.time(), "build_result": "BUILT"})
535:         manifest_payload = manifest.to_dict()
536:         _write_json_atomic(build_dir / "manifest.json", manifest_payload)
537:         metadata["manifest_file_sha256"] = _sha256_file(build_dir / "manifest.json")
538:         _write_json_atomic(build_dir / "cache_metadata.json", metadata)
539:         collection = manager.vector_store._collection
540:         collection_metadata = dict(collection.metadata or {})
541:         collection_metadata.update(
542:             {
543:                 key: metadata[key]
544:                 for key in (
545:                     "cache_schema_version",
546:                     "cache_key",
547:                     "source_manifest_sha256",
548:                     "chunk_manifest_sha256",
549:                 )
550:             }
551:         )
552:         collection.modify(metadata=collection_metadata)
553:         _validate_ready_dense_cache(
554:             cache_dir=build_dir,
555:             identity=identity,
556:             document_count=document_count,
557:             chunk_count=len(chunks),
558:             embedding_model=EMBEDDING_MODEL_NAME,
559:             query_prompt=query_prompt,
560:         )
561:         _release_build_handles(manager)
562:         os.replace(build_dir, cache_dir)
563:         return EvaluationDenseCacheResult(
564:             cache_dir=cache_dir,
565:             chroma_dir=cache_dir / "chroma",
566:             manifest_path=cache_dir / "manifest.json",
567:             metadata_path=cache_dir / "cache_metadata.json",
568:             identity=identity,
569:             status="CACHE_BUILT",
570:             elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic() - started,
571:         )
572:     finally:
573:         lock_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)

576: def _recompute_dense_expected_identity(
577:     identity: EvaluationDenseCacheIdentity,
578: ) -> EvaluationDenseCacheIdentity:
579:     """从 frozen expected inputs 机械重算 canonical identity。
580: 
581:     Authority 来自 frozen contract（model/dimension/local-only/normalize/prompt/
582:     splitter/chunk config/collection）+ 调用方提供的 source/chunk digests，不从
583:     待验证 metadata 反推。
584:     """
585:     return evaluation_dense_cache_identity(
586:         source_manifest_sha256=identity.source_manifest_sha256,
587:         chunk_manifest_sha256=identity.chunk_manifest_sha256,
588:         embedding_model=EMBEDDING_MODEL_NAME,
589:         embedding_dimension=DENSE_DIMENSION,
590:         embedding_local_files_only=DENSE_LOCAL_FILES_ONLY,
591:         normalize_embeddings=DENSE_NORMALIZE_EMBEDDINGS,
592:         embedding_query_prompt=DENSE_QUERY_PROMPT_NAME,
593:         splitter_identity=SPLITTER_IDENTITY,
594:         chunk_size=CHUNK_SIZE,
595:         chunk_overlap=CHUNK_OVERLAP,
596:         collection_name=COLLECTION_NAME,
597:     )
598: 
599: 
600: def load_evaluation_dense_cache(
601:     *,
602:     cache_dir: Path,
603:     expected_identity: EvaluationDenseCacheIdentity,
604:     expected_document_count: int,
605:     expected_chunk_count: int,
606:     embedding_model_path: Path,
607:     embedding_batch_size: int = 8,
608:     query_prompt_name: str | None = None,
609: ) -> tuple[VectorDBManager, EvaluationDenseCacheResult]:
610:     """按 external expected identity 加载 READY synthetic Dense cache（load-by-identity）。
611: 
612:     Authority 顺序：
613:     Expected Reality -> Validator -> Artifact Metadata / Manifest -> PASS/FAIL。
614:     要求 recomputed canonical identity == caller expected identity == directory identity
615:     == metadata cache identity，四者 exact match；不得由待验证 metadata 自证。
616:     并在创建 VectorDBManager（query adapter）之前，对调用方实际使用的 model ref 与
617:     query prompt 执行与 cold build 相同的 frozen fail-closed 校验。
618:     """
619:     # P1（Final）：caller query-adapter semantics 必须先于 VectorDBManager 创建强制。
620:     query_prompt = _assert_frozen_dense_query_config(
621:         embedding_model_path=embedding_model_path, query_prompt_name=query_prompt_name
622:     )
623:     resolved = Path(cache_dir).resolve(strict=True)
624:     if resolved.name != expected_identity.cache_key:
625:         raise ValueError("CACHE_INVALID: directory identity mismatch")
626:     recomputed = _recompute_dense_expected_identity(expected_identity)
627:     if recomputed.cache_key != expected_identity.cache_key:
628:         raise ValueError("CACHE_INVALID: expected identity is not frozen-canonical")
629:     if (
630:         expected_identity.embedding_dimension != DENSE_DIMENSION
631:         or expected_identity.source_manifest_sha256 != recomputed.source_manifest_sha256
632:         or expected_identity.chunk_manifest_sha256 != recomputed.chunk_manifest_sha256
633:     ):
634:         raise ValueError("CACHE_INVALID: expected identity semantic fields mismatch")
635:     metadata = json.loads((resolved / "cache_metadata.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
636:     if not isinstance(metadata, dict) or metadata.get("cache_status") != CACHE_READY:
637:         raise ValueError("CACHE_INCOMPLETE: cache is not READY")
638:     result = _validate_ready_dense_cache(
639:         cache_dir=resolved,
640:         identity=expected_identity,
641:         document_count=expected_document_count,
642:         chunk_count=expected_chunk_count,
643:         embedding_model=EMBEDDING_MODEL_NAME,
644:         query_prompt=DENSE_QUERY_PROMPT_NAME,
645:     )
646:     manager = VectorDBManager(
647:         db_persist_dir=str(result.chroma_dir),
648:         local_model_path=str(embedding_model_path),
649:         collection_name=COLLECTION_NAME,
650:         ingest_batch_size=32,
651:         embedding_batch_size=embedding_batch_size,
652:         query_prompt_name=query_prompt,
653:     )
654:     collection = manager.vector_store._collection
655:     collection_metadata = dict(collection.metadata or {})
656:     for key in (
657:         "cache_schema_version",
658:         "cache_key",
659:         "source_manifest_sha256",
660:         "chunk_manifest_sha256",
661:     ):
662:         if collection_metadata.get(key) != metadata.get(key):
663:             raise ValueError(f"CACHE_INVALID: collection metadata mismatch: {key}")
664:     if collection.count() != expected_chunk_count:
665:         raise ValueError("CACHE_INVALID: collection chunk count mismatch")
666:     return manager, result
667:

311: class _Observation:
312:     winner: RetrievalCandidate
313:     winner_kind: RetrievalEvaluationScoreKind
314:     channels: list[RetrievalEvaluationChannel]

317: class RetrievalEvaluationCaptureBuilder:
318:     """只保存当前 invocation 的原执行事实；所有 capture 失败均留在 sidecar。"""
319: 
320:     def __init__(
321:         self,
322:         *,
323:         run_id: str,
324:         invocation_index: int,
325:         invocation: RetrievalInvocation,
326:         max_context_chars: int,
327:     ) -> None:
328:         self.run_id = run_id
329:         self.invocation_index = invocation_index
330:         self.invocation = invocation
331:         self.max_context_chars = max_context_chars
332:         self.rewritten_query = invocation.original_query
333:         self._observations: dict[str, _Observation] = {}
334:         self._retrieved: tuple[RetrievalEvaluationCandidateItem, ...] = ()
335:         self._ranked: tuple[RetrievalEvaluationCandidateItem, ...] = ()
336:         self.capture_error_code: str | None = None
337: 
338:     def _fail(self, code: str) -> None:
339:         if self.capture_error_code is None:
340:             self.capture_error_code = code
341: 
342:     def capture_rewritten_query(self, value: str) -> None:
343:         try:
344:             if not isinstance(value, str):
345:                 raise TypeError
346:             self.rewritten_query = value
347:         except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - capture 失败必须与 Runtime 隔离
348:             self._fail("RAG_EVALUATION_REWRITE_CAPTURE_FAILED")
349: 
350:     def observe_candidates(
351:         self,
352:         candidates: Sequence[RetrievalCandidate],
353:         channel: RetrievalEvaluationChannel,
354:     ) -> None:
355:         try:
356:             kind = (
357:                 RetrievalEvaluationScoreKind.KEYWORD_FIXED_HEURISTIC
358:                 if channel is RetrievalEvaluationChannel.KEYWORD
359:                 else RetrievalEvaluationScoreKind.VECTOR_NORMALIZED_RELEVANCE
360:             )
361:             for candidate in candidates:
362:                 if channel is RetrievalEvaluationChannel.KEYWORD and not math.isclose(
363:                     candidate.score, 0.55, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=0.0
364:                 ):
365:                     raise ValueError
366:                 observation = self._observations.get(candidate.candidate_id)
367:                 if observation is None:
368:                     self._observations[candidate.candidate_id] = _Observation(
369:                         winner=candidate,
370:                         winner_kind=kind,
371:                         channels=[channel],
372:                     )
373:                     continue
374:                 if channel not in observation.channels:
375:                     observation.channels.append(channel)
376:                 if candidate.score > observation.winner.score:
377:                     observation.winner = candidate
378:                     observation.winner_kind = kind
379:         except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - capture 失败必须与 Runtime 隔离
380:             self._fail("RAG_EVALUATION_PROVENANCE_CAPTURE_FAILED")
381: 
382:     def _project_candidate(
383:         self,
384:         candidate: RetrievalCandidate,
385:         *,
386:         rank: int,
387:         reranked: bool,
388:     ) -> RetrievalEvaluationCandidateItem:
389:         observation = self._observations[candidate.candidate_id]
390:         metadata = candidate.metadata
391:         sheet = metadata.get("sheet_name")
392:         content_hash = metadata.get("content_hash")
393:         return RetrievalEvaluationCandidateItem(
394:             document_id=candidate.source_id,
395:             chunk_id=candidate.chunk_id,
396:             rank=rank,
397:             retrieval_rank=candidate.original_rank,
398:             retrieval_score=candidate.score,
399:             retrieval_score_kind=observation.winner_kind.value,
400:             retrieval_channels=tuple(item.value for item in observation.channels),
401:             rerank_rank=candidate.reranked_rank if reranked else None,
402:             rerank_score=candidate.reranked_score if reranked else None,
403:             rerank_score_kind=(
404:                 RetrievalEvaluationScoreKind.HEURISTIC_RERANK.value
405:                 if reranked
406:                 else None
407:             ),
408:             source=RetrievalEvaluationSource(
409:                 source_type=candidate.source.source_type,
410:                 collection=candidate.source.collection,
411:                 display_name=candidate.source.display_name,
412:                 document_version=candidate.source.document_version,
413:             ),
414:             page=candidate.source.page,
415:             section=candidate.source.section_path or None,
416:             sheet=sheet if isinstance(sheet, str) else None,
417:             content_hash=content_hash if isinstance(content_hash, str) else None,
418:             selected=False,
419:         )
420: 
421:     def capture_retrieved(self, candidates: Sequence[RetrievalCandidate]) -> None:
422:         try:
423:             if len(candidates) > MAX_RETRIEVED_ITEMS:
424:                 raise ValueError
425:             self._retrieved = tuple(
426:                 self._project_candidate(candidate, rank=index, reranked=False)
427:                 for index, candidate in enumerate(candidates, start=1)
428:             )
429:         except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - capture 失败必须与 Runtime 隔离
430:             self._fail("RAG_EVALUATION_RETRIEVED_CAPTURE_FAILED")
431: 
432:     def capture_ranked(
433:         self,
434:         candidates: Sequence[RetrievalCandidate],
435:         *,
436:         reranked: bool,
437:     ) -> None:
438:         try:
439:             if len(candidates) > MAX_RANKED_ITEMS:
440:                 raise ValueError
441:             self._ranked = tuple(
442:                 self._project_candidate(candidate, rank=index, reranked=reranked)
443:                 for index, candidate in enumerate(candidates, start=1)
444:             )
445:         except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - capture 失败必须与 Runtime 隔离
446:             self._fail("RAG_EVALUATION_RANKED_CAPTURE_FAILED")
447: 
448:     def finalize(self, result: RetrievalExecutionResult) -> RetrievalEvaluationSnapshot:
449:         if self.capture_error_code is not None:
450:             raise _capture_error(self.capture_error_code)
451:         if (
452:             len(self.invocation.original_query) > MAX_QUERY_CHARS
453:             or len(self.rewritten_query) > MAX_QUERY_CHARS
454:         ):
455:             raise _capture_error("RAG_EVALUATION_QUERY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED")
456:         if (
457:             len(result.final_chunks) > MAX_SELECTED_ITEMS
458:             or len(result.citations) > MAX_CITATIONS
459:         ):
460:             raise _capture_error("RAG_EVALUATION_ITEM_LIMIT_EXCEEDED")
461:         if sum(len(chunk.text) for chunk in result.final_chunks) > min(
462:             MAX_SELECTED_TEXT_CHARS, self.max_context_chars
463:         ):
464:             raise _capture_error("RAG_EVALUATION_SELECTED_TEXT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED")
465:         if result.retrieval_id != self.invocation.retrieval_id:
466:             raise _capture_error("RAG_EVALUATION_RETRIEVAL_ID_MISMATCH")
467:         selected_identities = {
468:             (chunk.source.source_id, chunk.source.chunk_id)
469:             for chunk in result.final_chunks
470:         }
471:         ranked_by_identity = {
472:             (item.document_id, item.chunk_id): item for item in self._ranked
473:         }
474:         retrieved = tuple(
475:             replace(
476:                 item,
477:                 selected=(item.document_id, item.chunk_id) in selected_identities,
478:                 rerank_rank=(
479:                     ranked_by_identity[(item.document_id, item.chunk_id)].rerank_rank
480:                     if (item.document_id, item.chunk_id) in ranked_by_identity
481:                     else None
482:                 ),
483:                 rerank_score=(
484:                     ranked_by_identity[(item.document_id, item.chunk_id)].rerank_score
485:                     if (item.document_id, item.chunk_id) in ranked_by_identity
486:                     else None
487:                 ),
488:                 rerank_score_kind=(
489:                     ranked_by_identity[
490:                         (item.document_id, item.chunk_id)
491:                     ].rerank_score_kind
492:                     if (item.document_id, item.chunk_id) in ranked_by_identity
493:                     else None
494:                 ),
495:             )
496:             for item in self._retrieved
497:         )
498:         ranked = tuple(
499:             replace(
500:                 item,
501:                 selected=(item.document_id, item.chunk_id) in selected_identities,
502:             )
503:             for item in self._ranked
504:         )
505:         retrieved_ids = {(item.document_id, item.chunk_id) for item in retrieved}
506:         ranked_ids = {(item.document_id, item.chunk_id) for item in ranked}
507:         if not selected_identities <= ranked_ids <= retrieved_ids:
508:             raise _capture_error("RAG_EVALUATION_IDENTITY_INVARIANT_FAILED")
509:         selected = tuple(
510:             RetrievalEvaluationSelectedItem(
511:                 document_id=chunk.source.source_id,
512:                 chunk_id=chunk.source.chunk_id,
513:                 selection_rank=index,
514:                 context_block_id=chunk.context_block_id,
515:                 citation_id=chunk.citation.citation_id,
516:                 context_content_hash=chunk.citation.context_content_hash,
517:                 text=chunk.text,
518:             )
519:             for index, chunk in enumerate(result.final_chunks, start=1)
520:         )
521:         citations = tuple(
522:             RetrievalEvaluationCitation(
523:                 citation_id=item.citation_id,
524:                 document_id=item.source_id,
525:                 chunk_id=item.chunk_id,
526:                 context_block_id=item.context_block_id,
527:                 context_content_hash=item.context_content_hash,
528:                 display_label=item.display_label,
529:                 page=item.page,
530:                 section=item.section_path or None,
531:             )
532:             for item in result.citations
533:         )
534:         retrieval_latency = None
535:         rerank_latency = None
536:         for record in result.stage_records:
537:             if (
538:                 record.stage is RetrievalStage.RETRIEVE
539:                 and record.status is not RetrievalStageStatus.SKIPPED
540:             ):
541:                 retrieval_latency = record.duration_ms
542:             if (
543:                 record.stage is RetrievalStage.RERANK
544:                 and record.status is not RetrievalStageStatus.SKIPPED
545:             ):
546:                 rerank_latency = record.duration_ms
547:         error = (
548:             RetrievalEvaluationError(
549:                 category=result.error.category.value,
550:                 safe_error_code=result.error.safe_error_code,
551:                 safe_message=result.error.safe_message,
552:                 stage=result.error.stage.value if result.error.stage else None,
553:                 failed_source_count=result.error.failed_source_count,
554:             )
555:             if result.error is not None
556:             else None
557:         )
558:         for reason in result.degradation_reasons:
559:             _bounded_scalar(reason, "degradation_reason")
560:         return RetrievalEvaluationSnapshot(
561:             schema_version=ARTIFACT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
562:             artifact_id=f"rag-eval://{self.run_id}/{self.invocation.retrieval_id}",
563:             run_id=self.run_id,
564:             attempt_id=self.run_id,
565:             retrieval_id=self.invocation.retrieval_id,
566:             invocation_index=self.invocation_index,
567:             retrieval_status=result.status.value,
568:             query=self.invocation.original_query,
569:             rewritten_query=self.rewritten_query,
570:             retrieved_items=retrieved,
571:             ranked_items=ranked,
572:             selected_items=selected,
573:             citations=citations,
574:             retrieval_latency_ms=retrieval_latency,
575:             rerank_latency_ms=rerank_latency,
576:             total_latency_ms=result.duration_ms,
577:             degraded=result.degraded,
578:             degradation_reasons=result.degradation_reasons,
579:             error=error,
580:             budget_usage=RetrievalEvaluationBudgetUsage(

582:                 embedding_calls=result.budget_usage.embedding_calls,
583:                 vector_queries=result.budget_usage.vector_queries,

585:                 document_reads=result.budget_usage.document_reads,

591: class RetrievalEvaluationCollector:
592:     """单 request、单 run 的并发安全 collector。"""
593: 
594:     def __init__(self, run_id: str) -> None:
595:         UUID(run_id)
596:         self.run_id = run_id
597:         self._lock = threading.Lock()
598:         self._next_index = 1
599:         self._started_ids: set[str] = set()
600:         self._snapshots: dict[int, RetrievalEvaluationSnapshot] = {}
601:         self._capture_error_code: str | None = None
602: 
603:     def _record_failure_locked(self, code: str) -> None:
604:         if (
605:             not isinstance(code, str)
606:             or len(code) > MAX_SCALAR_CHARS
607:             or not _CAPTURE_ERROR_CODE.fullmatch(code)
608:         ):
609:             code = "RAG_EVALUATION_CAPTURE_FAILED"
610:         if self._capture_error_code is None:
611:             self._capture_error_code = code
612: 
613:     def record_failure(self, code: str) -> None:
614:         with self._lock:
615:             self._record_failure_locked(code)
616: 
617:     def begin(
618:         self,
619:         *,
620:         run_id: str,
621:         invocation: RetrievalInvocation,
622:         max_context_chars: int,
623:     ) -> RetrievalEvaluationCaptureBuilder | None:
624:         with self._lock:
625:             if run_id != self.run_id:
626:                 self._record_failure_locked("RAG_EVALUATION_RUN_ID_MISMATCH")
627:                 return None
628:             if invocation.retrieval_id in self._started_ids:
629:                 self._record_failure_locked("RAG_EVALUATION_DUPLICATE_RETRIEVAL_ID")
630:                 return None
631:             if len(self._started_ids) >= MAX_ARTIFACTS_PER_RUN:
632:                 self._record_failure_locked("RAG_EVALUATION_ARTIFACT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED")
633:                 return None
634:             artifact_id = f"rag-eval://{run_id}/{invocation.retrieval_id}"
635:             if len(artifact_id) > MAX_SCALAR_CHARS or not _WIRE_ID.fullmatch(
636:                 invocation.retrieval_id
637:             ):
638:                 self._record_failure_locked("RAG_EVALUATION_RETRIEVAL_ID_INVALID")
639:                 return None
640:             index = self._next_index
641:             self._next_index += 1
642:             self._started_ids.add(invocation.retrieval_id)
643:         return RetrievalEvaluationCaptureBuilder(
644:             run_id=run_id,
645:             invocation_index=index,
646:             invocation=invocation,
647:             max_context_chars=max_context_chars,
648:         )
649: 
650:     def complete(
651:         self,
652:         builder: RetrievalEvaluationCaptureBuilder,
653:         result: RetrievalExecutionResult,
654:     ) -> None:
655:         try:
656:             snapshot = builder.finalize(result)
657:         except RetrievalEvaluationCaptureError as exc:
658:             self.record_failure(exc.code)
659:             return
660:         except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - projection 不得改变 retrieval result
661:             self.record_failure("RAG_EVALUATION_PROJECTION_FAILED")
662:             return
663:         with self._lock:
664:             if snapshot.run_id != self.run_id:
665:                 self._record_failure_locked("RAG_EVALUATION_RUN_ID_MISMATCH")
666:                 return
667:             if builder.invocation_index in self._snapshots or any(
668:                 item.retrieval_id == snapshot.retrieval_id
669:                 for item in self._snapshots.values()
670:             ):
671:                 self._record_failure_locked("RAG_EVALUATION_DUPLICATE_RETRIEVAL_ID")
672:                 return
673:             self._snapshots[builder.invocation_index] = snapshot
674: 
675:     def envelope(
676:         self,
677:     ) -> tuple[
678:         RetrievalEvaluationCaptureStatus,
679:         str | None,
680:         tuple[RetrievalEvaluationSnapshot, ...],
681:     ]:
682:         with self._lock:
683:             snapshots = tuple(
684:                 self._snapshots[index] for index in sorted(self._snapshots)
685:             )
686:             error_code = self._capture_error_code
687:         if error_code is None:
688:             status = RetrievalEvaluationCaptureStatus.COMPLETE
689:         elif snapshots:
690:             status = RetrievalEvaluationCaptureStatus.PARTIAL
691:         else:
692:             status = RetrievalEvaluationCaptureStatus.FAILED
693:         return status, error_code, snapshots
694: 
695: 
696: _CURRENT_COLLECTOR: ContextVar[RetrievalEvaluationCollector | None] = ContextVar(
697:     "retrieval_evaluation_collector", default=None
698: )
699: 
700: 
701: def current_retrieval_evaluation_collector() -> RetrievalEvaluationCollector | None:
702:     return _CURRENT_COLLECTOR.get()
703: 
704: 
705: def install_retrieval_evaluation_collector(
706:     collector: RetrievalEvaluationCollector,
707: ) -> Token[RetrievalEvaluationCollector | None]:
708:     return _CURRENT_COLLECTOR.set(collector)
709: 
710: 
711: def reset_retrieval_evaluation_collector(
712:     token: Token[RetrievalEvaluationCollector | None],
713: ) -> None:
714:     _CURRENT_COLLECTOR.reset(token)
715: 
716: 
717: __all__ = [
718:     "MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES",
719:     "RetrievalEvaluationCaptureStatus",
720:     "RetrievalEvaluationChannel",
721:     "RetrievalEvaluationCollector",
722:     "RetrievalEvaluationSnapshot",
723:     "current_retrieval_evaluation_collector",
724:     "install_retrieval_evaluation_collector",
725:     "reset_retrieval_evaluation_collector",
726: ]

630:     def _score_rag_candidate(
631:         self,
632:         content: str,
633:         relevance_score: float,
634:         query_terms: list[str],
635:         metadata: dict | None = None,
636:     ) -> float:
637:         """结合向量分数、正文命中和来源元数据做二次排序。"""
638:         normalized = content.lower()
639:         metadata = metadata or {}
640:         metadata_text = " ".join(
641:             str(metadata.get(key, ""))
642:             for key in (
643:                 "source",
644:                 "file_name",
645:                 "document_title",
646:                 "section_path",
647:                 "section_h1",
648:                 "section_h2",
649:                 "section_h3",
650:             )
651:         ).lower()
652:         lexical_hits = sum(1 for term in query_terms if term in normalized)
653:         metadata_hits = sum(1 for term in query_terms if term in metadata_text)
654:         term_frequency = sum(min(normalized.count(term), 3) for term in query_terms)
655:         length_bonus = min(len(content), 600) / 600 * 0.08
656:         coverage_bonus = min(lexical_hits, 4) * 0.06
657:         frequency_bonus = min(term_frequency, 5) * 0.015
658:         metadata_bonus = min(metadata_hits, 3) * 0.18
659:         title_like = (
660:             len(content) < 90
661:             or (content.lstrip().startswith("#") and len(content) < 160)
662:             or (content.count("\n") <= 1 and len(content.split()) <= 12)
663:         )
664:         title_penalty = 0.12 if title_like and not metadata_hits else 0.0
665:         return min(
666:             1.0,
667:             relevance_score
668:             + coverage_bonus
669:             + frequency_bonus
670:             + metadata_bonus
671:             + length_bonus
672:             - title_penalty,
673:         )

1: # PandaProbe 仓库级 Coding Agent 工作规范
2: 
3: 本文件适用于仓库根目录及全部子目录。子目录若以后增加更具体的 `AGENTS.md`，仅可细化本文件，不得放宽安全、Scope 与验证要求。
4: 
5: ## 1. Repository Overview
6: 
7: PandaProbe 是一个用于 AI Agent tracing、evaluation、monitoring 与 debugging 的开源工程平台。本仓库是 monorepo，主要运行组件为：
8: 
9: - `backend/`：Python 3.12+、FastAPI、Pydantic、async SQLAlchemy、PostgreSQL、Alembic、Redis、Celery/Beat、LiteLLM；依赖由 `uv` 和 `backend/uv.lock` 管理。
10: - `frontend/`：Node.js 20、Next.js 16 App Router、React 19、TypeScript、TanStack Query；依赖由 Yarn 和 `frontend/yarn.lock` 管理。
11: - Docker Compose：编排 `app`、`worker`、`beat`、`frontend`、PostgreSQL 16 与 Redis 7。
12: - `docs/`：Mintlify 文档站；文档中的能力声明必须再由当前源码或测试确认。
13: 
14: 仓库根目录不定义 Python package；`backend/` 是唯一的 Python/uv project。不要在根目录再次运行 `uv init` 或创建第二套依赖声明。
15: 
16: ## 2. Source of Truth
17: 
18: 按以下顺序判断目标与事实：
19: 
20: 1. 当前任务文件是本次目标、Scope 与 Acceptance Criteria 的权威来源；H 级 Handoff 中通常为 `.ai/handoff/<task_id>/00_task.md`。
21: 2. 当前真实源码、当前 Git diff 和本轮实际测试结果是实现状态的权威来源。
22: 3. 正式冻结的 Architecture / Contract 文档是其对应长期设计边界的权威来源。
23: 4. `README.md`、`CLAUDE.md`、其他说明、注释与 `10/20/30/40` Handoff 仅提供上下文，不能覆盖源码和测试事实。
24: 
25: Handoff 是阶段性交接材料，不是事实代理。每个 Agent 开始工作时必须重新阅读本文件、当前任务及当前阶段 Handoff，并重新检查源码、`git status` 和 `git diff`。发现文档与实现冲突时，保留证据并报告，不得靠猜测消解冲突。
26: 
27: ## 3. Repository Map
28: 
29: - `backend/app/main.py`：FastAPI composition root、lifespan、中间件、异常处理与 `/v1` router 注册。
30: - `backend/app/api/`：HTTP router、依赖、middleware、request context 与 rate limit；route 负责协议适配和编排。
31: - `backend/app/services/`：应用用例与业务编排。
32: - `backend/app/core/`：domain entity、repository protocol、evaluation metric 与 cadence 逻辑。
33: - `backend/app/infrastructure/`：PostgreSQL repository、Redis、auth adapter、Celery task、LLM provider 等外部适配器。
34: - `backend/app/registry/`：`Settings`、常量、安全与异常等横切配置。
35: - `backend/migrations/`：Alembic 环境及不可变的历史 migration。
36: - `backend/tests/unit/`、`backend/tests/integration/`：后端单元和真实 PostgreSQL/Redis 集成测试。
37: - `frontend/src/app/`：Next.js App Router 页面、layout 与路由边界。
38: - `frontend/src/components/`：provider、feature 和 UI 组件。
39: - `frontend/src/lib/`：API client、auth、query key 与共享工具。
40: - `frontend/src/__tests__/`、`frontend/e2e/`：Jest/jsdom 单元测试与 Playwright E2E。
41: - `docs/`：Mintlify `.mdx` 内容、`docs.json` 与 OpenAPI 快照。
42: - `.ai/handoff/`：大型 H 级任务的审计、决策、执行和 Final Gate 交接材料。
43: 
44: ## 4. Entry Points and Composition
45: 
46: - API：从 `backend/` 运行 `uvicorn app.main:app`；`backend/app/main.py` 是 composition root，`backend/app/api/v1/router.py` 汇总 `/v1` routes。
47: - Worker：`celery -A app.infrastructure.queue.celery_app worker`；任务实现在 `backend/app/infrastructure/queue/tasks.py`。
48: - Scheduler：同一 Celery app 以 `beat` 启动，周期任务配置位于 `celery_app.py`。
49: - Frontend：`frontend/src/app/layout.tsx` 是根 layout，`frontend/src/app/page.tsx` 是根页面；认证后的项目页面位于 `org/[orgId]/project/[projectId]/`。
50: - Migration：从 `backend/` 使用 `alembic.ini` 与 `migrations/env.py`，metadata 来自 `app.infrastructure.db.models.Base`。
51: - Docker API 镜像入口为 `backend/scripts/docker-entrypoint.sh`，随后执行 `app.main:app`。该脚本会尝试 `alembic upgrade head`，但当前实现会在 migration 失败后继续启动；不得仅凭容器已启动推断 migration 成功。
52: 
53: API 存在两类认证上下文：management plane 使用 Bearer JWT；data plane 可使用带项目 header 的 JWT 或 `X-API-Key` + `X-Project-Name`。修改 route 前先核对 `backend/app/api/dependencies.py` 中的 `get_api_context`、`get_data_plane_context` 与 `require_project`，不得绕过既有组织/项目隔离。
54: 
55: ## 5. Environment and Configuration
56: 
57: - 后端最低 Python 版本由 `backend/pyproject.toml` 定义为 `>=3.12`；当前 Docker 镜像使用 Python 3.13.2。后端安装使用 `uv sync --frozen`。
58: - 前端 Docker 使用 Node.js 20，安装使用 `yarn install --frozen-lockfile`。
59: - 后端配置唯一入口是 `backend/app/registry/settings.py::Settings`。当前 Pydantic 配置直接读取工作目录下 `.env` 和 `.env.development`；Compose 另通过 `env_file` 注入 `.env.${APP_ENV}`。不要假设 host 运行时会由 Pydantic 自动选择任意 `.env.${APP_ENV}`。
60: - 前端本地配置模板为 `frontend/.env.example`；`NEXT_PUBLIC_*` 值会进入客户端或在 build 时固化，尤其 `NEXT_PUBLIC_AUTH_ENABLED` 不是容器运行时开关。
```

21: ## 3. Problem Statement
22: 
23: 现有 Chroma v1 marker 只能证明 collection 的 chunk schema、配置路径/normalization/query prompt compatibility digest 与运行时 dimension；它不能证明 corpus、source set、chunk policy 或 ordered chunks。现有 BM25 serializer 只证明其算法和 tokenizer 冻结参数。故即使两个 artifact 各自合法，也不能证明来自同一 chunk space，RRF 若融合它们会产生不可观察的错误语义。

25: ## 4. Frozen Ownership Model
26: 
27: | Object / decision | Owner | Producer | Consumer |
28: |---|---|---|---|
29: | Canonical source and chunk truth | production KB build operation | one build coordinator | Dense builder、BM25 builder、preflight |
30: | `RetrievalIndexProvenance` | LocalAgent retrieval/index contract module | build coordinator | Chroma marker、BM25 metadata、startup validator、evaluation producer |
31: | Dense artifact | `VectorDBManager` / Chroma collection | build coordinator via existing manager | Dense retrieval adapter |
32: | BM25 artifact | new narrow `ProductionBm25ArtifactStore` | build coordinator using existing `Bm25SparseIndex` serializer | application-scoped BM25 retriever in WP2 |
33: | strategy configuration | immutable `Settings` captured at `server.py::lifespan()` | Settings parser | composition root and evaluation artifact producer |
34: | compatibility validation | composition root, before Router/runtime construction | provenance validator | startup readiness decision |
35: 
36: `AgentRouter` and `RetrievalExecutionService` remain retrieval consumers, not persistent-index lifecycle owners. `server.py::lifespan()` remains the sole production composition root.
37: 
38: ## 5. Canonical Corpus Identity Contract
39: 
40: The shared provenance has both fields below; neither absolute path, collection name, artifact filename nor ingest batch id alone is corpus proof.
41: 
42: | Field | Semantics / canonical input |
43: |---|---|
44: | `corpus_id` | human-readable configured collection label, equal to `LOCAL_AGENT_KB_COLLECTION`; diagnostic only |
45: | `source_manifest_sha256` | SHA-256 of canonical JSON array ordered by UTF-8 POSIX relative source path; each item is `{source, content_sha256}` where content digest is SHA-256 of source bytes |
46: 
47: The build coordinator owns source enumeration and digesting, using the existing supported-file rules. `source_manifest_sha256` is the content-derived corpus fingerprint. It is persisted in the full provenance manifest, Chroma v2 marker, BM25 metadata and active-generation descriptor; preflight compares exact values.
48: 
49: ## 6. Canonical Chunk Policy Contract
50: 
51: Production must create a canonical `chunk_policy` descriptor before splitting. Its digest is canonical JSON SHA-256 and it contains:
52: 
53: ```text
54: chunk_schema_version
55: splitter_ref = structure-aware-splitter.v2
56: chunk_size
57: chunk_overlap
58: chunk_content_format_ref
59: ```
60: 
61: `chunk_content_format_ref` versions the embedding text projection, including document/section/page/sheet prefix construction. It is required because changing that projection changes dense text semantics even when window boundaries do not change. `chunk_schema_version` is not a substitute for splitter or content-format identity.
62: 
63: The only build authority for size/overlap becomes production build configuration owned by `Settings`; the bootstrap CLI may expose no independent override for a production generation. A developer/evaluation-only override must create an explicitly non-production artifact and cannot publish an active production generation.
64: 
65: ## 7. Shared Chunk Manifest Contract
66: 
67: Production adopts the evaluation primitive concept but not its cache layout. From the single prepared chunk list, the coordinator creates an ordered manifest whose each item is:
68: 
69: ```text
70: ordinal, document_id, chunk_id, source, section_path, content_hash
71: ```
72: 
73: `ordinal` is the stable output order after canonical source ordering and canonical per-source chunk order. Ordering is significant. `chunk_manifest_sha256` is SHA-256 of canonical JSON for that ordered array. The full manifest is persisted once in the immutable generation directory; its digest is duplicated in both artifact metadata/marker.
74: 
75: Formal invariant:
76: 
77: ```text
78: HybridFuseAllowed(dense, bm25) iff
79:   dense.provenance.contract_version == bm25.provenance.contract_version == retrieval-index-provenance.v1
80:   and dense.provenance.source_manifest_sha256 == bm25.provenance.source_manifest_sha256
81:   and dense.provenance.chunk_policy_sha256 == bm25.provenance.chunk_policy_sha256
82:   and dense.provenance.chunk_manifest_sha256 == bm25.provenance.chunk_manifest_sha256
83:   and dense.provenance.generation_id == bm25.provenance.generation_id.
84: ```
85: 
86: No partial equality, candidate-id hash equality, or filename match can satisfy this invariant.
87: 
88: ## 8. Dense Provenance Contract
89: 
90: `RetrievalIndexProvenance` is a small shared value object/serializable schema, not a generic index framework. Its common fields are:
91: 
92: ```text
93: contract_version = retrieval-index-provenance.v1
94: generation_id
95: corpus_id
96: source_manifest_sha256
97: chunk_policy (and chunk_policy_sha256)
98: chunk_manifest_sha256
99: document_count
100: chunk_count
101: ```
102: 
103: Dense-specific fields remain on the Chroma marker: `embedding_compatibility_digest`, `embedding_asset_tree_sha256`, `embedding_dimension`, `normalize_embeddings`, and `query_prompt_name`. The marker must not persist raw absolute model paths. The full shared provenance digest and all shared digests above are required Chroma v2 marker fields.
104: 
105: ## 9. Dense Generation Storage, Directory Layout and Active Descriptor
106: 
107: ### 9.1 Dense physical isolation
108: 
109: Choose **generation-specific Chroma collection names in the one configured Chroma persistent directory**. This matches the current `VectorDBManager`, which already opens a caller-specified `collection_name` through `Chroma(..., persist_directory=settings.chroma_dir)`, and avoids treating Chroma's internal SQLite/files as LocalAgent-owned state.
110: 
111: `LOCAL_AGENT_KB_COLLECTION` remains the logical collection/corpus label. It is never the physical generation locator. Let `collection_key = sha256(UTF-8 logical collection name).hexdigest()[:16]` and let `generation_id` be a lowercase canonical UUID string without braces. The physical Dense collection name is exactly:
112: 
113: ```text
114: la_{collection_key}_g_{generation_id-with-hyphens-removed}
115: ```
116: 
117: `VectorDBManager` opens a generation by receiving this physical name as `collection_name` and the unchanged configured `settings.chroma_dir` as `db_persist_dir`. Building this fresh collection therefore cannot modify the current active Dense collection. After publication, the old physical collection remains readable and may be reactivated by replacing the active descriptor; generation cleanup is manual and out of scope. A locator/collection name is never corpus identity or provenance proof.
118: 
119: ### 9.2 Retrieval root and immutable generation layout
120: 
121: The retrieval root is exactly `Path(LOCAL_AGENT_CHROMA_DIR) / "localagent_retrieval" / collection_key`. `collection_key` is opaque and prevents configured collection text from becoming a filesystem path segment. The layout is:
122: 
123: ```text
124: <LOCAL_AGENT_CHROMA_DIR>/
125:   chroma.sqlite3 and Chroma-managed files
126:   localagent_retrieval/<collection_key>/
127:     active.json
128:     generations/<generation_id>/
129:       retrieval_index_manifest.json
130:       bm25_index.json
131:       artifact_metadata.json
132: ```
133: 
134: There is exactly one full shared provenance/chunk manifest, `retrieval_index_manifest.json`, per generation. Dense provenance is stored in its Chroma v2 marker; BM25 metadata and the active descriptor only carry its digest and a relative locator, not duplicate full manifests.
135: 
136: ### 9.3 Active-generation descriptor
137: 
138: `active.json` has schema version `localagent-active-generation.v1` and all fields below are required:
139: 
140: ```json
141: {
142:   "schema_version": "localagent-active-generation.v1",
143:   "generation_id": "<canonical UUID>",
144:   "provenance_contract_version": "retrieval-index-provenance.v1",
145:   "provenance_sha256": "<64 lowercase hex>",
146:   "corpus_id": "<logical configured collection label>",
147:   "dense": {
148:     "persist_dir_ref": "LOCAL_AGENT_CHROMA_DIR",
149:     "collection_name": "la_<collection_key>_g_<uuidhex>"
150:   },
151:   "bm25_artifact_path": "generations/<generation_id>/bm25_index.json",
152:   "provenance_manifest_path": "generations/<generation_id>/retrieval_index_manifest.json",
153:   "artifact_metadata_path": "generations/<generation_id>/artifact_metadata.json"
154: }
155: ```
156: 
157: The production build coordinator is the sole writer. `server.py::lifespan()` / the application-scoped provenance loader is the reader. All descriptor paths are forward-slash relative paths resolved from retrieval root; absolute paths, empty segments, `.`/`..`, drive-qualified paths, symlinks, and any resolved path outside retrieval root are rejected. `dense.persist_dir_ref` is a fixed literal, not a user path.
158: 
159: Publication is precisely: write canonical UTF-8 JSON plus newline to a unique temporary sibling of `active.json`; flush and `os.fsync` the file; close it; then call `os.replace(temp, active.json)` on the same retrieval-root filesystem. The staged generation and Chroma collection are fully built and validated before this step. Directory fsync after replacement is intentionally not required in this local desktop contract; abrupt power-loss durability of the directory entry is an accepted limitation, while no partially written descriptor is accepted by normal readers. Previous active descriptors are recoverable from an operator-selected prior generation by writing a new validated descriptor with the same protocol.
160: 
161: ### 9.4 Publication authority and startup ordering
162: 
163: The active descriptor is authoritative only for locating the active Dense/BM25 generation. The Chroma v2 marker is authoritative for Dense-local provenance. Exact equality between descriptor, marker, BM25 metadata, and the one full manifest proves a usable Dense/BM25 generation.
164: 
165: For `HYBRID_RRF`, startup ordering is fixed:
166: 
167: ```text
168: read + schema-validate active.json
169: → resolve and containment-validate relative locators
170: → read full manifest and recompute/verify provenance_sha256
171: → open the descriptor-named Dense collection and validate its v2 marker
172: → recompute embedding asset-tree digest and validate Dense fields
173: → validate BM25 files/digests/frozen serializer contract
174: → exact-compare all common provenance fields and generation_id
175: → construct application-scoped validated dependencies
176: → construct Router/runtime services
177: ```
178: 
179: Any failure ends in the startup requiredness behavior already frozen in §16; no generation is selected by scanning Chroma collections or generation directories.
180: 
181: ## 10. BM25 Provenance Contract
182: 
183: The artifact is an immutable generation directory containing:
184: 
185: ```text
186: bm25_index.json              # existing Bm25SparseIndex serializer payload
187: retrieval_index_manifest.json # full RetrievalIndexProvenance + ordered chunk manifest
188: artifact_metadata.json        # schema/status, shared provenance digest, frozen BM25 fields,
189:                               # document/chunk counts and SHA-256 for both files
190: ```
191: 
192: BM25-specific metadata is exactly `BM25_INDEX_SCHEMA_VERSION`, `BM25_ALGORITHM_REF`, `BM25_TOKENIZER_REF`, `BM25_K1`, and `BM25_B`, plus file digests. Existing `Bm25SparseIndex.load()` stays the ranking/parameter validator; WP1 adds no algorithm or tokenizer change.
193: 
194: The configured artifact root and exact file locators are frozen in §9.2–§9.3. Loading requires all files, READY status, file digest verification, frozen BM25 validation, descriptor/manifest equality, and exact common provenance equality with the active Dense marker. Missing, corrupt or incompatible artifacts are invalid, never regenerated at startup.
195: 
196: ## 11. Embedding Asset Identity Decision
197: 
198: `ACCEPTED_LIMITATION = NO` for same-path/same-dimension asset replacement. `DIGEST_ROOT` is the resolved configured `LOCAL_AGENT_EMBEDDING_MODEL_PATH` directory. The digest input contract is exact: recursively walk every entry below that root; every regular file participates, including hidden files and any cache/tooling/generated file or directory contents. There are **no exclusions, ignore lists, cache allowlists, or mtime/ctime/absolute-path inputs**.
199: 
200: Each manifest item is exactly `{ "path": <relative POSIX path>, "content_sha256": <SHA-256 of file bytes> }`; items are sorted by `path`; `embedding_asset_tree_sha256` is SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON for that array (sorted keys, compact separators). Directories contribute only through recursive traversal. Any symlink (file or directory), unreadable entry, broken link, socket, device, FIFO, or other special filesystem entry causes `EMBEDDING_MODEL_ASSET_INVALID`; it is not skipped. This rejects ambiguous traversal and makes model contents, not volatile metadata, the identity.
201: 
202: The build computes and persists it; startup recomputes it before accepting a non-empty v2 Dense generation. Mismatch is `REBUILD_REQUIRED` / provenance failure. A missing or unreadable asset follows existing `knowledge_base_required`: required KB fails startup; optional KB starts explicitly degraded. This costs one local model-tree scan per application startup but provides deterministic safety for an offline local model and avoids an operator-maintained revision that could drift. This digest supplements rather than replaces existing configured path/prompt/normalization/dimension compatibility checks.
203: 
204: ## 12. Marker / Manifest Versioning Decision
205: 
206: Chroma marker evolves from version 1 to version 2. Required v2 fields are existing v1 fields plus `generation_id`, `provenance_contract_version`, `provenance_sha256`, `corpus_id`, `source_manifest_sha256`, `chunk_policy_sha256`, `chunk_manifest_sha256`, document/chunk counts, and `embedding_asset_tree_sha256`.
207: 
208: Existing non-empty v1 collections are `REBUILD_REQUIRED` for `HYBRID_RRF`; missing facts must never be inferred from chunk rows. Automatic migration/rebuild is forbidden. `BASELINE` may continue using a v1 collection under the current v1 preflight rule during rollout; a v2 build is required before Hybrid can be selected. An explicit build creates a new generation and publishes it only after all validation passes.
209: 
210: ## 13. Ingestion / Artifact Build Contract
211: 
212: The production build operation must:
213: 
214: 1. enumerate and digest sources once;
215: 2. split once with the canonical chunk policy;
216: 3. create one ordered chunk manifest and provenance object;
217: 4. build the new Dense Chroma generation and BM25 artifact from that exact in-memory prepared chunk set;
218: 5. validate counts, all metadata, marker and file digests; then atomically replace one active-generation descriptor.
219: 
220: The descriptor names the generation and both artifact locations. A failed build leaves the prior descriptor/generation active; a partial new generation is unreachable and can be operator-cleaned. This is a local publish-pointer protocol, not a distributed transaction. The server never clears, rebuilds, creates BM25 artifacts, or changes the active descriptor at startup.
221: 
222: ### 13.1 Production chunk build authority
223: 
224: Add immutable Settings fields `knowledge_chunk_size` and `knowledge_chunk_overlap`, read from `LOCAL_AGENT_KB_CHUNK_SIZE` and `LOCAL_AGENT_KB_CHUNK_OVERLAP`, with defaults `1400` and `180`. Both are strict integers: size is at least 1; overlap is at least 0; after parsing, `knowledge_chunk_overlap < knowledge_chunk_size` is required or `SettingsValidationError` fails closed. The production build coordinator always passes these two Settings values to `split_documents` and persists them in `chunk_policy`; no caller value may supersede them.
225: 
226: Current `scripts/bootstrap_local_kb.py --chunk-size/--chunk-overlap` remain available only with an explicit `--build-purpose=development`. A development build must label its manifest `purpose=development` and is forbidden from writing/replacing `active.json`. In the default `--build-purpose=production`, supplying either option is a parser error rather than an invisible override. Thus production has exactly one chunk-policy authority while developers retain an explicit non-production seam.
227: 
228: ## 14. Retrieval Strategy Contract
229: 
230: Introduce `LOCAL_AGENT_RETRIEVAL_STRATEGY` as a strict Settings enum: `BASELINE` and `HYBRID_RRF`. Default remains `BASELINE` until WP3 evaluation and final-gate approval; there is no implicit strategy selection from artifact presence or failure.
231: 
232: The composition root captures the value once. `HYBRID_RRF` requires a valid active v2 Dense/BM25 generation and, until WP2 installs the query graph, fails startup with a safe `RETRIEVAL_STRATEGY_NOT_IMPLEMENTED` error. Rollback is an explicit configuration change to `BASELINE` plus process restart, never a per-request fallback.
233: 
234: ## 15. Runtime Composition / Lifecycle Contract
235: 
236: At `lifespan()` startup, the composition root loads/validates the active generation and constructs application-scoped Dense and BM25 retrieval dependencies only for `HYBRID_RRF`. `ApplicationRuntimeServices` owns their lifecycle/closeable registration. A dedicated provenance validator, invoked before Router construction, is the only component allowed to decide dense/BM25 compatibility.
237: 
238: WP2 wires these validated dependencies into one hybrid retrieval adapter/service that reuses `HybridRrfRetriever`. It must not make `AgentRouter` open index files, reconstruct provenance, or own application shutdown.
239: 
240: ## 16. RRF Candidate Identity Contract
241: 
242: Fusion identity is the semantic pair `(document_id, chunk_id)`, matching `RrfChannelCandidate.stable_identity`; `RetrievalCandidate.candidate_id = sha256(source_id|chunk_id)` is a local transport/dedup identifier and is insufficient for fusion. The hybrid mapper must extract `source_id` as `document_id`, retain the original `chunk_id`, and reject missing/inconsistent metadata before constructing RRF candidates.
243: 
244: `HybridRrfRetriever` remains authoritative for fixed RRF parameters, contiguous ranks, per-channel budgets, tie breaking and fused provenance. Its existing deterministic ordering is preserved. Context-level content-hash dedup remains downstream and must not replace fusion identity.
245: 
246: ## 17. Failure / Degradation Matrix
247: 
248: | Situation | `BASELINE` | `HYBRID_RRF` |
249: |---|---|---|
250: | v2 Dense marker/provenance invalid | existing required/degraded KB policy | startup fail if KB required; KB unavailable/degraded if optional; never select baseline silently |
251: | BM25 missing, corrupt, or provenance mismatch | irrelevant | same startup KB requiredness policy; Hybrid graph is not constructed |
252: | model asset digest mismatch | existing v1 behavior for legacy baseline | as invalid v2 Dense generation |
253: | Dense search failure | current fail-closed retrieval result | fail closed for that request |
254: | BM25 search failure | irrelevant | fail closed for that request |
255: | only one query channel returns candidates | current behavior | fail closed; no single-channel RRF and no baseline fallback |
256: | RRF execution failure | irrelevant | fail closed for that request |
257: 
258: `knowledge_base_required=false` permits an explicitly KB-degraded application; it does not permit an active Hybrid request to substitute a different strategy. All Hybrid failure/degradation states must expose a safe reason code and strategy in events/artifacts.
259: 
260: ## 18. Observability Contract
261: 
262: Safe retrieval events and metrics gain only bounded, content-free fields: `retrieval_strategy`, `generation_id`, `provenance_sha256`, Dense candidate count, BM25 candidate count, RRF fused count, selected count, per-channel latency, channel failure/reason code, and final retrieval status. `generation_id` and digest values are opaque identifiers; no source paths, source contents, model paths, raw query, tool output or retrieved document text enters runtime safe events.
263: 
264: Evaluation sidecars may retain their existing bounded item evidence. Production event sequence/terminal ownership, journal safe-payload allowlists and metric cardinality rules remain unchanged.
265: 
266: ## 19. Evaluation Artifact Evolution
267: 
268: Introduce `rag-evaluation-artifact.v2`, while consumers continue accepting v1. V2 adds `retrieval_strategy` and opaque `provenance_sha256` at snapshot level and permits these new typed values:
269: 
270: ```text
271: RetrievalEvaluationChannel: BM25, RRF
272: RetrievalEvaluationScoreKind: BM25_RAW_SCORE, RRF_SCORE
273: ```
274: 
275: Fused entries retain contributing channels and source channel ranks so retrieval, fusion and final ranking are distinguishable. V1 producer/consumer behavior remains readable; a V2 LocalAgent producer must not be deployed until AgentEvalOps accepts V2. LocalAgent owns producing runtime facts; AgentEvalOps owns parsing, metrics and evaluation; dataset ground truth is unchanged.
276: 
277: ## 20. Memory Boundary
278: 
279: Knowledge index/provenance work must not change Memory store, authorization, scope, lifecycle, formation, persistence or governance. Long-term Memory is not a source in the corpus/source/chunk manifest. Shared `ContextBuilder` use remains permitted, with existing `RAG_DOCUMENT` and Memory context types preserved.
280: 
281: ## 21. Accepted Limitations
282: 
283: - No online refresh, remote manifest service, artifact registry, distributed transaction or automatic cleanup is introduced.
284: - A v1 baseline collection remains usable only as legacy baseline during rollout; it is not provenance-safe for Hybrid.
285: - The full model asset digest adds startup I/O by design; it is bounded to local approved model files and is preferred to accepting silent same-path replacement.
286: - `os.replace` publication does not request a directory fsync; a power loss immediately after replacement may require operator recovery using a prior validated generation.
287: - Cross-Encoder productionization is out of scope for WP1 and WP2.
288: 
289: ## 22. Rejected Alternatives
290: 
291: 1. **Copy Phase3 evaluation cache into production** — rejected: its corpus IDs/layout are evaluation-specific and production needs a separate lifecycle.
292: 2. **Treat collection name/path or ingest batch ID as corpus identity** — rejected: none proves source content or chunk policy.
293: 3. **Build Dense and BM25 independently then compare a few candidate IDs** — rejected: partial overlap cannot establish shared chunk space.
294: 4. **Auto-migrate v1 marker or auto-rebuild at server startup** — rejected: missing provenance cannot be reconstructed reliably and startup must not mutate knowledge data.
295: 5. **On Hybrid failure silently switch to baseline or single-channel RRF** — rejected: it changes strategy semantics without an operator decision and invalidates evaluation attribution.
296: 6. **Use only configured model path/dimension** — rejected: it misses same-path, same-dimension asset substitution.
297: 
298: ## 23. WP1 Implementation Scope
299: 
300: ZCode/DeepSeek implementation is bounded to the following foundation; it must not wire the Hybrid query graph.
301: 
302: | Area | Expected change |
303: |---|---|
304: | `core/settings.py`, configuration docs/tests | strict strategy enum; `LOCAL_AGENT_KB_CHUNK_SIZE=1400` / `LOCAL_AGENT_KB_CHUNK_OVERLAP=180`; `0 <= overlap < size`; no request-time or production CLI override |
305: | `core/knowledge_base/document_loader.py` | exported stable chunk-policy/content-format refs and canonical manifest helper, reusing existing split behavior |
306: | new narrow provenance/build module | frozen `RetrievalIndexProvenance`; canonical source/chunk/model-asset manifests; exact `collection_key`/physical collection convention; retrieval-root containment checks; descriptor schema and `os.replace` publication |
307: | `core/knowledge_base/vector_db_manager.py` | open descriptor-specified generation collection; v2 marker read/write/preflight; no Chroma internal DB access |
308: | new `production_bm25_artifact.py` | exact `generations/<uuid>/` file layout, metadata, atomic staging writes, file/invariant validation; reuse `Bm25SparseIndex` |
309: | `scripts/bootstrap_local_kb.py` or a narrow replacement production-build command | production uses Settings chunk values, stages isolated Chroma collection + generation directory, validates, then publishes `active.json`; development-only overrides cannot publish |
310: | `server.py` / application services | strategy-aware v1/v2 preflight and validated artifact loading only; no BM25 query execution |
311: | `core/runtime/retrieval_evaluation.py` and AgentEvalOps artifact parser | V2 schema acceptance/production plumbing, preserving V1 reader compatibility |
312: | `docs/runtime/` and README | configuration, rebuild and safe-operation contract updates |
313: 
314: ## 24. WP2 Deferred Scope
315: 
316: WP2 alone may construct the validated application-scoped BM25 retriever and hybrid adapter, map semantic identities, invoke `HybridRrfRetriever`, integrate its results with the existing retrieval/context pipeline, and implement the per-query failure behavior frozen above. It must not alter provenance/marker ownership, RRF formula, BM25 algorithm, Memory contracts, Cross-Encoder lifecycle or the strategy default.
317: 
318: ## 25. Required Tests
319: 
320: WP1 focused tests must cover: canonical source ordering/digest; policy digest changes for splitter/size/overlap/content format; ordered chunk manifest drift; every-regular-file asset-tree digest including hidden files; symlink/special/unreadable asset rejection; Chroma v1 baseline versus v2 Hybrid preflight; exact Dense/BM25 provenance mismatch rejection; corrupt/missing BM25 file rejection; descriptor schema/path traversal/escape rejection; failed staged generation leaves prior descriptor active; atomic descriptor replacement; strict strategy parsing/default; production CLI override rejection; development-only output cannot publish; and no automatic rebuild.
321: 
322: Regression tests must retain existing `test_vector_db_manager.py`, `test_bm25_sparse_index.py`, `test_hybrid_rrf_retriever.py`, retrieval integration/execution tests, and V1 evaluation artifact parsing. AgentEvalOps adds V2 artifact acceptance and metrics tests; no dataset modification is permitted.
323: 
324: ## 26. Final Decision Summary
325: 
326: ```text
327: CANONICAL_CORPUS_PROOF = source_manifest_sha256
328: CANONICAL_CHUNK_PROOF = chunk_policy_sha256 + ordered chunk_manifest_sha256
329: DENSE_BM25_FUSION_REQUIRES_EXACT_SHARED_PROVENANCE = YES
330: CHROMA_MARKER_VERSION_FOR_HYBRID = 2
331: V1_COLLECTION_HYBRID_COMPATIBLE = NO (REBUILD_REQUIRED)
332: MODEL_ASSET_ATTESTATION = full approved local asset-tree SHA-256
333: RETRIEVAL_STRATEGY_DEFAULT = BASELINE
334: HYBRID_STARTUP_OR_REQUEST_FALLBACK_TO_BASELINE = FORBIDDEN
335: MEMORY_CONTRACT_CHANGE = NO
336: CROSS_ENCODER_PRODUCTIONIZATION = OUT_OF_SCOPE
337: DENSE_GENERATION_STORAGE_CONTRACT_FROZEN = YES
338: ACTIVE_GENERATION_DESCRIPTOR_CONTRACT_FROZEN = YES
339: ACTIVE_GENERATION_PUBLICATION_CONTRACT_FROZEN = YES
340: EMBEDDING_ASSET_DIGEST_INPUT_CONTRACT_FROZEN = YES
341: PRODUCTION_CHUNK_BUILD_AUTHORITY_FROZEN = YES
342: WP1_WP2_BOUNDARY_FROZEN = YES
343: READY_FOR_ZCODE_EXECUTION = YES
344: ```
345: 
346: Evidence consulted: current `core/settings.py`, `server.py::lifespan`, `VectorDBManager`, document loader, BM25/RRF/evaluation contracts, WP1 Scout, WP0 audit, current Git state, and AgentEvalOps retrieval artifact/metric consumer source. No production source, tests, configuration, index, cache, dataset, dependency, or AgentEvalOps files were modified by this decision stage.
347:

51:         event_emitter: StepEventEmitter | None,
52:         spec: RetrievalExecutionSpec,
53:         requested_timeout_seconds: float,
54:         fault_controller: FaultInjectionController | None = None,

66:             spec=spec,

70:     def raise_if_cancelled(self) -> None:
71:         """按 Run Cancellation、Run Deadline、Retrieval Deadline 的顺序检查。"""
72:         try:
73:             self.run_context.raise_if_inactive()
74:         except RunDeadlineExceededError:
75:             raise
76:         if self.remaining_seconds() <= 0:
77:             raise RetrievalDeadlineExceededError("retrieval deadline exceeded")

79:     def remaining_seconds(self) -> float:

81:         remaining = max(0.0, self.retrieval_deadline_monotonic - time.monotonic())
82:         run_remaining = self.run_context.remaining_seconds()

84:             remaining = min(remaining, max(0.0, run_remaining))

150:         match = _ARTIFACT_ID.match(self.artifact_id)
151:         if not match:
152:             raise ValueError("invalid artifact_id format")
153:         run_id, retrieval_id = match.groups()
154:         if run_id != self.run_id or retrieval_id != self.retrieval_id:
155:             raise ValueError("artifact_id does not match run_id/retrieval_id")
156:         if self.attempt_id != self.run_id:
157:             raise ValueError("attempt_id must equal run_id")

159:         selected_ids = {(item.document_id, item.chunk_id) for item in self.selected_items}
160:         ranked_ids = {(item.document_id, item.chunk_id) for item in self.ranked_items}
161:         retrieved_ids = {(item.document_id, item.chunk_id) for item in self.retrieved_items}
162:         if not selected_ids <= ranked_ids <= retrieved_ids:
163:             raise ValueError("selected/ranked/retrieved identity invariant violated")
164:         return self

229: class RagMetricEvaluatorResolver:
230:     """解析冻结的 RAG metric evaluator identity（chunk-level 与 document-level）。"""
231: 
232:     def __init__(self, document_projection: DocumentProjection | None = None) -> None:
233:         self._document_projection = document_projection
234: 
235:     def resolve(self, spec: EvaluatorSpec) -> ResolvedEvaluator:
236:         """把 suite spec 解析为对应的 deterministic evaluator."""
237:         reverse_recall = {value: key for key, value in RECALL_IDS.items()}
238:         reverse_ndcg = {value: key for key, value in NDCG_IDS.items()}
239:         reverse_document_recall = {value: key for key, value in DOCUMENT_RECALL_IDS.items()}
240:         reverse_document_ndcg = {value: key for key, value in DOCUMENT_NDCG_IDS.items()}
241:         if spec.evaluator_version == DOCUMENT_EVALUATOR_VERSION:
242:             if spec.evaluator_id == DOCUMENT_MRR_ID:
243:                 evaluator = RagMetricEvaluator(
244:                     DOCUMENT_MRR_ID, document_projection=self._document_projection
245:                 )
246:             elif spec.evaluator_id in reverse_document_recall:
247:                 evaluator = RagMetricEvaluator(
248:                     spec.evaluator_id,
249:                     reverse_document_recall[spec.evaluator_id],
250:                     document_projection=self._document_projection,
251:                 )
252:             elif spec.evaluator_id in reverse_document_ndcg:
253:                 evaluator = RagMetricEvaluator(
254:                     spec.evaluator_id,
255:                     reverse_document_ndcg[spec.evaluator_id],
256:                     document_projection=self._document_projection,
257:                 )
258:             else:
259:                 raise ValueError(f"unsupported document RAG evaluator: {spec.evaluator_id}")
260:             return ResolvedEvaluator(spec.evaluator_id, spec.evaluator_version, evaluator)
261:         if spec.evaluator_version != EVALUATOR_VERSION:
262:             raise ValueError(f"unsupported RAG evaluator version: {spec.evaluator_version}")
263:         if spec.evaluator_id == MRR_ID:
264:             evaluator = RagMetricEvaluator(MRR_ID)
265:         elif spec.evaluator_id in reverse_recall:
266:             evaluator = RagMetricEvaluator(spec.evaluator_id, reverse_recall[spec.evaluator_id])
267:         elif spec.evaluator_id in reverse_ndcg:
268:             evaluator = RagMetricEvaluator(spec.evaluator_id, reverse_ndcg[spec.evaluator_id])
269:         else:
270:             raise ValueError(f"unsupported RAG evaluator: {spec.evaluator_id}")
271:         return ResolvedEvaluator(spec.evaluator_id, spec.evaluator_version, evaluator)
272: 
273:

275:     "DOCUMENT_EVALUATOR_VERSION",
276:     "DOCUMENT_MRR_ID",
277:     "DOCUMENT_NDCG_IDS",

1: """Document-level 投影与指标 —— Chunk ranking 到 benchmark document ranking 的纯函数投影。
2: 
3: BEIR qrels 是 document-level ground truth；LocalAgent retrieval 返回 chunk-level ranking。
4: 本模块把 artifact 的 retrieved/ranked/selected chunk 序列投影为去重后的 document 序列
5: （同一 document 由其在当前 stage 排名最高的 chunk 决定 document rank），投影结果仍是
6: RagEvaluationArtifactV1，从而直接复用现有 Recall@K / MRR / NDCG 纯函数。
7: 
8: 投影对未知 document identity fail closed（UnknownBenchmarkDocumentError），不静默丢弃
9: 或猜测 benchmark document id。
10: """
11:

14: from __future__ import annotations

24: class UnknownBenchmarkDocumentError(ValueError):
25:     """Artifact 中出现无法映射回 benchmark document 的 document identity。"""
26: 
27:     def __init__(self, document_id: str) -> None:
28:         super().__init__(
29:             f"{DOCUMENT_PROJECTION_ERROR_CODE}: artifact document identity "
30:             f"{document_id!r} cannot be projected to a benchmark document"
31:         )
32:         self.document_id = document_id
33: 
34: 
35: class DocumentProjection:
36:     """LocalAgent chunk document_id 到 benchmark document id 的不可变投影映射。"""
37: 
38:     __slots__ = ("_mapping", "_reverse")
39: 
40:     def __init__(self, mapping: Mapping[str, str]) -> None:
41:         values = list(mapping.values())
42:         if len(values) != len(set(values)):
43:             raise ValueError("benchmark document ids must be unique in projection mapping")
44:         self._mapping: dict[str, str] = dict(mapping)
45:         self._reverse: dict[str, str] = {value: key for key, value in mapping.items()}
46: 
47:     @classmethod
48:     def from_manifest(cls, manifest: Mapping[str, Any]) -> "DocumentProjection":
49:         """从 BEIR ingest manifest 的 documents 列表构造投影映射。"""
50:         documents = manifest.get("documents")
51:         if not isinstance(documents, Sequence) or not documents:
52:             raise ValueError("manifest must contain a non-empty documents list")
53:         mapping: dict[str, str] = {}
54:         for entry in documents:
55:             if not isinstance(entry, Mapping):
56:                 raise ValueError("manifest document entry must be an object")
57:             document_id = entry.get("document_id")
58:             benchmark_document_id = entry.get("benchmark_document_id")
59:             if not isinstance(document_id, str) or not isinstance(benchmark_document_id, str):
60:                 raise ValueError("manifest document entry requires string identity fields")
61:             if document_id in mapping and mapping[document_id] != benchmark_document_id:
62:                 raise ValueError(f"conflicting projection for document {document_id!r}")
63:             mapping[document_id] = benchmark_document_id
64:         return cls(mapping)
65: 
66:     def benchmark_document_id(self, document_id: str) -> str:
67:         """返回 benchmark document id；未知 identity fail closed。"""
68:         try:
69:             return self._mapping[document_id]
70:         except KeyError as error:
71:             raise UnknownBenchmarkDocumentError(document_id) from error
72: 
73:     def localagent_document_id(self, benchmark_document_id: str) -> str:
74:         """返回 LocalAgent document_id；未知 benchmark id fail closed。"""
75:         try:
76:             return self._reverse[benchmark_document_id]
77:         except KeyError as error:
78:             raise UnknownBenchmarkDocumentError(benchmark_document_id) from error
79: 
80:     def __len__(self) -> int:
81:         return len(self._mapping)
82: 
83:     def document_ids(self) -> frozenset[str]:
84:         """返回全部 LocalAgent document identity。"""
85:         return frozenset(self._mapping)

88: def project_document_sequence(
89:     ordered_items: Sequence[tuple[int, str]],
90:     projection: DocumentProjection,
91: ) -> list[tuple[str, int]]:
92:     """把按 stage rank 排序的 (rank, document_id) 序列投影为去重 document 序列。
93: 
94:     同一 benchmark document 的重复 chunk 只保留最小 rank（该 stage 排名最高的 chunk
95:     决定 document 位置）；输出顺序按该最小 rank 排列，并重新编号为 1..n。
96:     """
97:     best_rank: dict[str, int] = {}
98:     for rank, document_id in ordered_items:
99:         benchmark_id = projection.benchmark_document_id(document_id)
100:         current = best_rank.get(benchmark_id)
101:         if current is None or rank < current:
102:             best_rank[benchmark_id] = rank
103:     ordered = sorted(best_rank.items(), key=lambda entry: entry[1])
104:     return [(benchmark_id, position) for position, (benchmark_id, _rank) in enumerate(ordered, 1)]
105: 
106: 
107: def project_artifact_to_documents(
108:     artifact: RagEvaluationArtifactV1,
109:     projection: DocumentProjection,
110: ) -> RagEvaluationArtifactV1:
111:     """把 chunk-level artifact 投影为 document-level artifact（复用 v1 schema）。
112: 
113:     投影后 document identity 使用 (benchmark_document_id, benchmark_document_id)；
114:     selected ⊆ ranked ⊆ retrieved 的层间不变量在投影后保持。分数、channels、source
115:     等字段取自决定该 document rank 的 chunk。
116:     """
117:     retrieved_ordered = sorted(artifact.retrieved_items, key=lambda item: item.retrieval_rank)
118:     retrieved_documents = project_document_sequence(
119:         [(item.retrieval_rank, item.document_id) for item in retrieved_ordered], projection
120:     )
121:     retrieved_by_document = _first_by_document(retrieved_ordered, projection)
122:     retrieved_position = {doc: position for doc, position in retrieved_documents}
123: 
124:     ranked_ordered = sorted(artifact.ranked_items, key=lambda item: item.rank)
125:     ranked_documents = project_document_sequence(
126:         [(item.rank, item.document_id) for item in ranked_ordered], projection
127:     )
128:     ranked_by_document = _first_by_document(ranked_ordered, projection)
129: 
130:     selected_ordered = sorted(artifact.selected_items, key=lambda item: item.selection_rank)
131:     selected_documents = project_document_sequence(
132:         [(item.selection_rank, item.document_id) for item in selected_ordered], projection
133:     )
134:     selected_by_document = _first_by_document(selected_ordered, projection)
135: 
136:     payload = artifact.model_dump(mode="json")
137:     payload["retrieved_items"] = [
138:         _projected_ranked_item(
139:             retrieved_by_document[document_id], document_id, position, position, position
140:         )
141:         for document_id, position in retrieved_documents
142:     ]
143:     payload["ranked_items"] = [
144:         _projected_ranked_item(
145:             ranked_by_document[document_id],
146:             document_id,
147:             position,
148:             retrieved_position.get(document_id, position),
149:             position,
150:         )
151:         for document_id, position in ranked_documents
152:     ]
153:     payload["selected_items"] = [
154:         _projected_selected_item(selected_by_document[document_id], document_id, position)
155:         for document_id, position in selected_documents
156:     ]
157:     payload["citations"] = []
158:     return RagEvaluationArtifactV1.model_validate(payload)
159:

161: def _first_by_document(items: Sequence[Any], projection: DocumentProjection) -> dict[str, Any]:
162:     """按已排序 item 序列保留每个 document 的首个（最优 rank）item。"""
163:     result: dict[str, Any] = {}
164:     for item in items:
165:         benchmark_id = projection.benchmark_document_id(item.document_id)
166:         if benchmark_id not in result:
167:             result[benchmark_id] = item

11: ## Configuration Source
12: 
13: 唯一项目级来源是 `core.settings.Settings.load()`。仓库根目录提供 `.env.example` 作为配置名称/模板文档，**Application 不自动加载该文件**（不存在 dotenv loader）；operator 可将其内容复制为 PowerShell 环境变量模板。环境变量在 `server.py`/`main.py` import/进程启动时读取，运行中的请求不动态重载，因此下表均为 `restart_required=yes`。
14: 
15: 配置解析统一严格：显式 bool 只接受大小写无关的 `1/0/true/false`；显式 int/float 严格词法解析并要求有限值；显式 enum/profile/backend 未知或空值直接失败。数值字段在 Settings Semantic Validation 中按真实 consumer contract 校验 range（timeout/capacity/窗口/计数类 ≥1，cost 类 ≥0，GPU layers ≥-1（`-1`=全部层 offload、`0`=CPU、正整数=指定 offload 层数），port 1..65535）。非法显式值不再静默变 False、clamp 或回落到默认，全部 fail closed；只有缺失 env 才应用默认值。`SettingsValidationError` 是唯一 Settings 级异常类型（`ValueError` 子类），只保存安全码、env 名与 reason code。
16: 
17: 配置 precedence（只由 `Settings.load()` 执行一次）：
18: 
19: ```text
20: code safe default < environment profile default < model resource preset < explicit environment variable < derived value
21: ```
22: 
23: Environment Profile 只管理少量字段的默认值；Model Profile 只管理 fast/balanced/deep 的资源字段；两套字段集合不重叠。显式 env 始终最高优先，但不能绕过 Production 安全不变量（如 Production remote 必须 HTTPS 且 TLS verification=True）。
